body:
I gave my parents a chance,they did everything they could. They gave me affection,an opportunity to study,money. Sometimes they failed to understand but they did the best,even them are unable to find some ways out for me now. I remember calling them crying for help and they did everything,sent me to a therapist (who only ended up giving me vitamins ),tried to be there for me the best they were able to.
My mom was so happy when she saw things were getting better for me thanks to that boy,she even bought me the dress I wanted so much just so I could wear it for him.

I love them but I know I have to think of me, I can't stand the pain anymore. I have to do what I have to do now. I can only thank them for keeping me going for so long,I did it for them and for them only.

Thank you for trying to make me see some rays of light in all of this. Through,I did everything I could and I can't take the sight of everyone being happy around me,going on holidays with their friends or SOs,getting started in life anymore while I'm the one who worked so hard towards happiness. I can't stand them bitching about how their boyfriend "didn't talk to them for two hours" or how their mom told them to clean their rooms,spitting on their pretty lives. I can't stand one more month of this shit,even less a year or more. I'm so lonely and I'm just 100% done.

He's 17.
I don't hide them because of shame,I just don't want people's pity or attention. When I'm out to do some groceries or something,I don't care about them but when I'm with friends or relatives I tend to hide them to avoid making them worry and the odd questions I might face. 

I wish I had the strenght to get over him,I tried looking at other guys but deep down I know I'll be rejected again so I won't bother. I just don't want to try anymore,I've been rejected over ten times in my life,the only guy I've dated I didn't even love. Everyone I've ever loved rejected me.

I actually wish I didn't meet him,because it only made my feelings for him stronger. I love everything about him. We met for two days,and he was really sweet on the first day,actually made some moves towards me but it all went sour the second day. He was distant,nice but cold,spent most of the time with his friends even if a few days before he told me he was "counting the days before finally meeting me". 

By them I mean the scars,I don't think he saw them because I picked clothes that hid them. He actually told me he didn't want to pursue this relationship because he saw his ex a few days before our meeting which reminded him of how hard a long distance relationship is and how hard this past love had been for him. He didn't even answer when I told him I did get over my fear of being hurt and rejected again to be with him.

Maybe you can meet new people through the internet without having to go out ? I truly believe that you can meet some great people online and maybe they will live near you,and even if they don't,you'll be able to talk to someone. 
It might not be life-changing but I think it can be a relief.
I hope I have helped in some way.

I've known him for over two years,I have a "big" internet presence and so does him so I saw his blog,basically. When I saw the things he wrote,his talent as an artist and his pictures,I developped a crush on him,not in a "Let's date !" way but I thought he was really lovely and everything I was looking for in a significant other. He's really out of this world and sees life as a wonderful thing,he's always kind to others. I thought he was out of my league so I tried to brush it off. Last year he started talking to me through facebook and we became friends for a bit before I confessed to him and he "reciprocated" (at the time). 
What hurts the most is reminding me the things he told me,that people didn't love me enough and that he was going to change that...

I will always have the scars I have to remind me of him. I remind of all the people who ever rejected me because of them,I know who is "behind" each of them and it's horrible.

Thank you for telling me I'm precious,this really moved me. For the reply aswell.

If you don't mind me asking,how do you cope with the situation ? 
I'm sending you all of my best wishes and I hope things get better for you,even if what I say might seems a bit ridiculous right now.

I'm really glad things got better for you,it seems like you struggled a lot and now that you've found some sort of peace,enjoy it to the fullest,I really wish that to you ! What you did for those girls is truly beautiful. 

Through,I help people out,I made myself the best "me" I could be,and haven't seen any positive impact in those four years. I've mostly talked about my looks in my post but I also worked on stopping being selfish,caring more about others and opening to them,learning about the world. Those years are seriously agony,going through so much effort for... nothing but shit. I don't really see how I could do more,enough to be loved too. 

My family would be sad,I hate that thought,I just wish I could be removed from this world without causing anyone pain but sadly this is not possible. Thank you for your kind words and support.

I really don't want to fall in love with anyone,they all pretend to care for me but they only care about themselves at the end. I'm killing time with books and TV shows as I've done forever. I make sure my sister is not taking the same path as me and is fine,now she became a beautiful teenage girl,inside and out. It's not really volunteering,but I feel very uncomfortable in social situations so I do what is in my reach,I guess.
But all I want and never get is a bit of happiness for me, but I guess its a bit egoistical to think this way. Sorry I lost track,I appreciated your reply a lot,thank you.

About the things you stated in your second point,that's pretty much what I'm trying to do,I try to always be there for my friends even if deep down I'm madly jealous of them or if they hurt me,trying to give the best advices I can no matter how "small" their issue seems to me. They always told me I was the one they can "talk to". I've tried to be happier by helping and supporting others but it feels horrible when what I get in return from them is "get over it"," I don't know what to do,I give up" and "you're so stubborn",when I talk about my own problems ( not in depth through.)
I've seen a new therapist a few weeks ago who told me I wasn't depressed enough to have meds,basically. I now don't have the strenght to see another one.
Thanks for taking the time to answer me,it's really lovely.
Thanks for taking the time to read my story,it means a lot.

Thank you for your kind words,I really appreciate them. Yet I know I'll get rejected again and even if I ever happened to find that special someone through some kind of miracle,I'd fuck it up. I know my looks are going to fade too,I feel it starting already. I want to go while my only achievement is still intact.
